title: Bandit Slots
subtitle: Multi-Armed Bandit Problem
overview: A row of slot machines, each with unknown payout rates. The challenge: find the best machine while minimizing losses from testing bad ones.
rules: Each machine has a hidden payout probability
You don't know which machine is best
Balance exploring new machines vs exploiting known good ones
Goal: maximize total winnings over time

algorithm.name: ε-Greedy & Softmax
algorithm.description: ε-Greedy randomly explores with probability ε, otherwise picks the best-known option. Softmax assigns probabilities proportional to estimated values.

keyInsight: This is the fundamental exploration-exploitation dilemma in AI. Too much exploration wastes resources; too little means missing the best option.
